questionText: Must the engulfing candle's body engulf the prior body, or the prior candle's full range?
reason: He says the candle 'has eaten the candlestick to the left' but also requires a 'body candlestick close above'. Body-engulfs-body and body-closes-beyond-range are different detectors that fire on different bars. Consistent with his body-based structure rule (CLAIM|ALEX_G|20260727|020), but not disambiguated here.
